abstract: A loudspeaker in a closed box is modeled as a rigid sphere with an axially moving cap. For an axisymmetric cone-velocity profile, its radiation impedance is written as a network. Each spherical-harmonic mode has an impedance rational in frequency, realized exactly as a finite passive ladder of masses and compliances terminated in a resistance. Ideal transformers set by Legendre coefficients couple these ladders; truncated modes reduce to a residual mass. Despite the different geometry, the impedance resembles that of a baffled piston but, at equal volume velocity, has half its low-frequency resistance and about three quarters of its radiation mass.

oneSentenceThesis: 论文把刚性球上轴向运动球冠的辐射阻抗分解到球面模态，用理想变压器连接每个模态的有限 Cauer 梯形，并用残余质量截断无限模态，从而给出可按 N 控制带宽的无源网络；数值上复现声功率级数并在小帽极限接近障板活塞，但尚未与实测辐射阻抗比较。
originalTitle: Passive ladder-network representation of the radiation impedance of a spherical cap on a rigid sphere
readerTitle: 球冠辐射阻抗的无源梯形网络：从模态到可仿真电路
